ideas.title: Smack Bugs for Bucks 🪰
ideas.hook: Giant bugs crawl into your backyard. Swing a fly swatter, launch them as far as you can, and get paid by distance and how rare the bug is.
core_loop: Wait for a bug to land on your launch pad
Time your swing on the power bar
Earn cash by distance x bug rarity
Log new bugs in your bug book
Buy bigger swatters and unlock the next yard
ideas.twist: Rare bugs fight back: a giant beetle can flip the swing and launch you instead, so you have to dodge before you swing.
monetization: Luck pass for rare bug spawns
retention: Bug book with mythic bugs to complete
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 2.69 (up 0.27 this week) with 32 new games, led by Throw Food For Animals at 316,388 CCU at 50 days. Giant / huge is at 1.73 with 14 new games, and Bug Evolution [🦟] already pulls 30,263 CCU at 29 days. The "___ for ___" formula is still at 1.63.
ideas.differentiator: Throw Food launches an item at animals; here the creature is the projectile and can turn the tables on you.

ideas.title: +1 Ladder Rung 🪜
ideas.hook: Every step you take adds +1 rung to your ladder. Grow it tall enough to reach a giant's castle in the clouds.
core_loop: Walk to add +1 rung
Plant the ladder and climb
Grab sky coins on the way up
Spend coins on lighter, stronger ladders
Rebirth to reach the next giant's floor
ideas.twist: Tall ladders sway. Other players can shake the base of yours, so you have to balance on the way up or fall back to the ground.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 2.04 with 38 new games even after slipping 0.35 this week, and the "+1 ___" title formula sits at 2.14. +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (29,709 CCU at 19 days) and Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 (26,385) show climbing works, and the +1 x Obby pair already has 4 new games with 33,215 CCU. Giant / huge is at 1.73.
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games grow your body; this grows a physical ladder other players can see and shake.

ideas.title: Escape the Giant Chef 🍳
ideas.hook: You are bite-sized and stuck in a giant's kitchen. Run across counters, hide in cups and reach the mouse hole before the chef cooks you.
core_loop: Spawn on the counter as a tiny snack
Run, jump and hide from the chef's hands
Grab crumbs for coins on the way
Reach the exit before the timer ends
Spend coins on snack skins and speed perks
ideas.twist: One player each round can become the chef, seeing the kitchen from above and grabbing runners with giant hands.
retention: New kitchens (bakery, sushi bar, candy factory)
ideas.why_now: Interiors are the top rising map style at 2.08 with 56 new games, led by DONT SPLASH (82,358 CCU at 21 days). Escape / run is at 1.66 (up 0.24) with 36 new games, Food / candy is at 1.50 ([🍨CH2] Eat THE Ice Cream 10,442 CCU) and Giant / huge at 1.73.
ideas.differentiator: DONT SPLASH has a monster in a pool; here the threat is a giant you can see from a tiny point of view, and a player can control it.

ideas.title: Sell Old Fits 🧥
ideas.hook: Buy bags of old clothes for cheap, restyle them into outfits and sell them in your secondhand shop. Picky customers pay more for the right look.
core_loop: Buy mystery clothing bags
Wash, cut and restyle pieces
Dress mannequins in your window
Customers rate and buy outfits
Upgrade racks, mirrors and the shop floor
ideas.twist: Players can shop at each other's stores, and a top-rated outfit becomes the server's trend, raising prices for everyone selling that style.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.62 with 32 new games (🧸 My Small Business 19,093 CCU at 21 days, Sell a Million Sushi 12,753). Dress Up is up 0.28 to 1.27 (Evermore High 🦢 24,548, [🎃] Facecard: Makeup Showdown (Junior) 10,046 at 17 days), and the Sell x Tycoon pair has 7 new games with 37,072 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell fixed goods; here you make each product by styling it, and other players set the trend.

ideas.title: Guess the Engine 🏁
ideas.hook: Hear an engine, see a blurry outline and guess the car. Every right answer puts that car in your garage for the drag race at the end of the round.
core_loop: Listen to an engine and see a silhouette
Pick the car faster than others
Win the car into your round garage
Drag race your best car at round end
Earn coins for skins and hint tokens
ideas.twist: Wrong guesses give your rivals' cars a nitro boost, so guessing fast but wrong can cost you the race.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess x Vehicles is a top gap (score 3.16). Vehicle Sim is up 0.35 to 1.68 with 29 new games, and Can You Pass A Driving Test? reached 19,023 CCU at 20 days with a test format. Quiz / guess is at 1.20 and realistic art is rising at 1.78.
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Car quizzes stop at the answer; here answers become cars you race the same round.

ideas.title: Roll Rooms for Loot 🎲
ideas.hook: Your party rolls a giant die to build the dungeon one room at a time: treasure, trap, shop or boss. Push your luck or cash out.
core_loop: Roll the giant die to make the next room
Clear it together (fight, dodge or loot)
Choose: keep going or cash out
Spend loot on heroes and luckier dice
Unlock deeper dungeons
ideas.twist: Each player can secretly swap one face of the die before a roll, so a teammate might be loading the dice for loot or for a boss.
retention: Luck boosts and offline earnings from your guild hall
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards is up 0.36 to 1.20 with 11 new games ([⚡] Steal a Superpower! 15,987 CCU at 28 days, [🎉UPD 2] Roll A Stickman! 6,631). Fantasy / medieval is at 1.39, and Dice x Fantasy is still an open gap (2.43).
ideas.differentiator: Dice games roll for units; here the roll builds the level your team plays.

ideas.title: Grow a Burger Tree 🍔
ideas.hook: Plant a tree that grows buns, patties and lettuce. Stack the tallest burger you can and feed it to a hungry giant for cash.
core_loop: Plant and water burger trees
Harvest buns, patties and toppings
Stack a burger on the counter
Feed it to the giant for cash by height
Buy rarer seeds (golden patty, rainbow cheese)
ideas.twist: Taller burgers pay more but wobble. Add one layer too many and it falls, so you choose when to stop.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is up 0.30 to 1.46 with 39 new games, and giant crops are working: [UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 hit 14,229 CCU at 17 days. Giant / huge is at 1.73 and Food / candy at 1.50, with Throw Food For Animals at 316,388 CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Garden games sell crops; here crops become a stacking skill check with a giant customer.

ideas.title: Doodle Ink in the Yard 🖋️
ideas.hook: You are the yard artist in a cartoon prison. Inmates ask for doodles on their jumpsuits and walls; draw them well and get paid in snacks and favors.
core_loop: Take an order (a dragon, a flag, a name)
Draw it on the jumpsuit or wall
Get rated on how close it is
Earn snacks to trade for better pens and paint
Unlock new cell blocks with bigger jobs
ideas.twist: Guards patrol the yard. If they spot you drawing, hide the pen and act normal, or lose your art supplies.
retention: Wall of fame for top-rated art
ideas.why_now: Paint / create x Prison / police is the top gap in the data (score 5.22). Paint / create is at 2.11 (up 0.21, high confidence) with 19 new games (🎬 Make a Cartoon! 18,629 CCU at 28 days), and Prison / police is up 0.32 to 1.44 with 15 new games (13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] 13,243).
ideas.differentiator: Prison games are about escaping; this one is about making art inside, with a stealth layer from the guards.

ideas.title: Stunt Double Studio 🎬
ideas.hook: Build a movie stunt on your film lot with ramps, cars and explosions. Your ragdoll stunt double does it on camera, and the crowd pays for the best crash.
core_loop: Pick a scene script (car jump, fall, explosion)
Place ramps, props and cameras on your lot
Yell action and watch the ragdoll stunt
Release the film and earn cash by crowd score
Unlock bigger sets and props
ideas.twist: Players can volunteer as each other's stunt doubles, so a friend's ragdoll can wreck your shot or win it.
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is at 2.10 with 17 new games (Ragdoll Physics 🩸 28,760 CCU, [🧪] Ragdoll Research 24,664 at 10 days). Paint / create is at 2.11 (🎬 Make a Cartoon! 18,629), Hit / swing / launch is at 2.69, and the Hit x Race / drive pair has 4 new games with 40,468 CCU. Realistic art is rising at 1.78.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll sandboxes have no goal; here every crash is a scene you design and get scored on.

ideas.title: Shelter the Town 🌪️
ideas.hook: Dig a storm shelter under your plot. When a disaster hits, townsfolk and other players pay to get in, and better rooms mean bigger fees.
core_loop: Dig and build shelter rooms
Stock food, beds and lights
Disaster warning: open the doors and take fees
Repair damage after the storm
Expand deeper for bigger disasters
ideas.twist: If your walls fail, water or lava floods in mid-storm and your guests run to a rival's shelter, taking their fees with them.
retention: Disaster schedule with rare events (meteor, volcano)
ideas.why_now: Disaster / weather is at 1.76 with 10 new games ([🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! 20,997 CCU, [⏳] Create A Disaster💥 7,188 at 21 days). Interiors are the top rising map style at 2.08, and Tycoon / base building is at 1.09 with 82 new games (🧸 My Small Business 19,093).
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games have you survive the event; here you profit from it by running the safe place.
